gaps.jd_requirement: Experience with marketing attribution and customer segmentation
gaps.resume_weakness: Resume mentions 'marketing analytics' but doesn't use 'attribution' or 'customer segmentation' keywords
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'My marketing analytics work included multi-touch attribution modeling—I built models that allocated $5M in ad spend across channels and segmented customers into 8 cohorts for targeted campaigns.'

gaps.resume_weakness: Resume shows 'marketing analyst' but no specific tenure
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'I have 3 years of marketing analytics experience. I've managed campaigns with $15M total budget and improved ROAS from 2.1x to 3.4x through data-driven optimization.'

role_content_refined: Analyze marketing campaign performance and ROI
Build customer segmentation models for targeting
Support marketing strategy with data insights
role_team_insights.next_title_1_3yr: Senior Marketing Analyst or Marketing Manager

offer_strategy.script: Based on my 3 years in marketing analytics where I improved ROAS from 2.1x to 3.4x and managed $15M in campaign budgets, and market data showing Marketing Analysts at Target ranging $78K-$98K, I'm targeting $92K total compensation. I'm excited about growth toward senior analyst or manager roles. How does that align with your budget?

questions.question: Tell me about a time when a marketing campaign underperformed and what you did
questions.star_blueprint: A holiday campaign had 40% lower CTR than historical average. I analyzed by channel and found creative fatigue. I recommended refreshing ad creative and adjusting targeting. CTR recovered to normal levels within 5 days.
questions.resume_anchor: Optimized underperforming campaigns improving ROAS by 60%

questions.question: How would you measure the incrementality of a new marketing channel?
questions.interviewer_intent: Testing causal inference and experimentation knowledge
questions.star_blueprint: I'd run a geo-holdout test: launch the new channel in 70% of markets, keep 30% as control. Measure lift in conversions vs control group using difference-in-differences. Key: ensure markets are matched on key attributes.
questions.resume_anchor: Built attribution models allocating $5M ad spend across channels
